text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling batch infra apply in eu-west-1 at 22:00 UTC tonight. Plan touches Route53 tenant rename (blue->blue-2), bastion subnet move, and an IAM role update. Plan passed `terraform plan` locally. Can someone volunteer to run `terraform apply` and watch deploybot? I'll own smoke tests.

deploybot: Deploybot: plan available at https://deploys/redwood/1751122334. Quiet mode will be enabled 30m before window.

kevin: +1 to provider pin. We should pin aws provider to 4.1.x to avoid drift with new provider. Add this to providers.tf:
```
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.1" }
  }
}
```

sarah: I can run apply. I'll be online from 21:30 UTC. @maria please post exact apply command and tf workspace.

maria: workspace=eu-west-prod, run command: `TF_WORKSPACE=eu-west-prod terraform apply -var-file=eu-west.tfvars -auto-approve` — do not run with `-target` unless we talk.

ian: Rollback playbook in case Route53 rename breaks DNS health checks:
1) Run `terraform state mv` to move any moved resources back (if necessary)
2) Revert commit on tf branch and `git push`, then `terraform apply` with previous commit lock
3) If harder, restore from S3 state snapshot: `aws s3 cp s3://tf-state-backups/eu-west-1/backup-YYYYMMDD.tfstate ./recovery.tfstate` and `terraform init -reconfigure && terraform apply -state=./recovery.tfstate`

olivia: Add pre/post smoke tests: curl internal health endpoints, verify bastion accepts SSH from jump host, and ensure IAM role can assume from services. I'll prepare a short checklist.

sarah: Roger. I'll wait for the provider pin PR to merge. @kevin can you open it now?

kevin: PR opened: https://git/redwood/infra/pull/432 — includes provider pin + changelog entry. :white_check_mark:

maria: OK moving to quiet mode at 21:30 UTC. @deploybot please enable quiet window and bump alerting thresholds.

deploybot: Quiet mode enabled for channel #eng-infra from 21:30 to 23:00 UTC. Will send apply-start and apply-end messages.

maria: Final call — any objections?

kevin: none.

olivia: :thumbsup: Good to go.

sarah: Starting apply at 22:02 UTC. Will report status.
